# OpenCode Zen free-tier gate — distilled

**Canonical sources.** Do not edit this file as if it were the record; edit the runbooks.

- `../omp-opencode-free-tier-403.md` — the full investigation, with the live probe matrix,
  console-source locations, and the resolved fix. 167 lines.
- `../pi-opencode-free-tier-fix.md` — the Pi-side runbook for the same gate. 74 lines.
- `../lessons.md` — the dated `2026-09-22` lesson entry.

This file is a short operational summary only. The gate is a moving target: it changed
several times in September 2026, so **re-probe before trusting any of this**, and before
claiming a fix works.

## Symptom

Third-party clients calling free Zen models get:

```
403 {"type":"error","error":{"type":"FreeTierError",
     "message":"Error from provider (Console): OpenCode's free tier can only be used from within OpenCode"}}
```

An older, looser variant reads `MissingSessionID` and is a header-*presence* gate. The
`FreeTierError` wording is the stricter deployment and is what was actually hit.

## Gate rules (probed live 2026-09-22)

Endpoint `https://opencode.ai/zen/v1`:

| Requirement | Rule |
|---|---|
| `User-Agent` | Must **start with** `opencode/`. `opencode/1.18.32` passes. `omp/…`, `OMP/…`, `okcomputer/…`, or absent → 403. |
| `x-opencode-session` | Must be `ses_` + 26 chars (12 hex unix-ms + 14 base62). **Format check only** — fresh, fabricated, or a reused static value all pass. A uuidv7 fails. |
| `Authorization` | **Not checked on the free tier.** `auth: none` works. A *bogus* key returns 401; valid headers with no auth return 200. |
| Body shape | Enforced, and easy to get wrong — see below. |

### Body shape is part of the gate

This is the least obvious part and the most common reason a "correct" header set still 403s.

- `/zen/v1/responses` needs `stream:true`, a non-empty `tools` array, an `input` array, and a
  bare model id — **plus** a CLI-shaped body: non-empty `instructions` and a multi-message
  `input`. A minimal single-message body returns `FreeTierError` even with valid headers and
  a fresh `ses_`.
- `/zen/v1/chat/completions` is **route-gated differently** and requires `stream:true`.
  `stream:false` returns `FreeTierError`.

**Unresolved conflict, recorded honestly:** the canonical runbook contains two
contradictory 2026-09-22 conclusions about `/chat/completions` — one section reports the
route as dead with `503 "Endpoint is unavailable"`, and a later section in the same file
reports it working with `stream:true` for completions-model free ids. Both are dated the
same day. The later finding is the more useful one but the contradiction is unresolved in
the source; re-probe rather than trusting either.

## Why Pi and omp broke, and the fix shape

- **Pi** sends `x-opencode-session: <uuidv7>` and sets a `User-Agent` only for Cloudflare
  models, so opencode requests shipped a uuid session and a non-opencode UA. Pi's
  `mergeProviderAttributionHeaders()` applies user-config headers **last**, so a static
  config header overrides the generated one. Fix is config-only.
- **omp** force-sets `x-opencode-session` to a **uuidv7** and sets `User-Agent` (set-if-absent)
  in `uW()`, but **only when the provider id is exactly `opencode-zen` or `opencode-go`**.
  On those ids, config headers can never pass. The workaround is a mirror provider under a
  different id (e.g. `omp-zen`) so the force-set is skipped entirely, with `auth: none` and
  static headers.
- `models.yml` supports a **per-model `api`** setting, so one mirror provider can serve both
  `openai-responses` and `openai-completions` model ids. Two separate mirror providers were
  merged into one on this evidence.

## Operational warnings

- **omp rewrites `~/.omp/agent/config.yml` on self-update.** Roles get added and `default`
  can silently reset to a broken model. Check it after every version bump — this actually
  happened mid-session (v18.2.8 → v18.2.11) and `default` had to be restored.
- A stale static `ses_` can start failing. Regenerate it and update the config; the UA must
  stay `opencode/*`.
- `ollama-cloud` returns 401 because ollama.com rejects the stored key, not because it is
  missing. Needs a fresh key from ollama.com, or the `OLLAMA_CLOUD_API_KEY` env var.
- `jev-1.13-free` returns a genuine 500 and is unusable.
- `~/.omp/logs/http-400-requests/*.json` captures are **openrouter** noise, not opencode
  evidence. Do not cite them.

## Secret handling

**Never inline a credential in this folder or any memory file.** Read keys in-memory at
probe time and record only the HTTP status. A plaintext `sk-…` key was found in
`../pi-opencode-free-tier-fix.md` on 2026-09-26 and redacted from the working tree, but it
remains in **git history** — treat that key as compromised and rotate it.
